label: Week 8
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-25T01:03Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Sunday of the Week 7 slate (stamped vibe week reg-8, Sun-Sat rule). SNF KC@SEA in progress at pull; MNF PHI@DAL pending. Loudest by count: PIT, CLE, DET, MIN, GB, NYJ, BAL, NO, SF, CAR. CLE (#Browns) and NYJ (#Jets, NHL Jets) volumes likely inflated by hashtag noise. Cross-club items kept only where this club was a game participant or trade party. Dropped mostly college football (Texas-Ole Miss, Miami, Boise State, Kansas-Baylor, Tennessee-South Carolina, Alabama, Gophers, Lobos), other sports (Knicks, NHL Jets/Devils, Nuggets, F1 Austin, WNBA, Galatasaray, Kraken), celebrity/creator stunts (Steve Will Do It $1M bet, Burna Boy halftime, Nikki Bella, Gillie Da Kid), uniform/merch/food (Texans all-red, Eminem spaghetti sandwich, Panthers look), broadcast gags (Warner name mix-up, Collinsworth), UFL Stampede logo, politics, betting parlays, and many cross-club duplicates. JAX, NE, WSH had only passing mentions.

items.title: Cardinals Fans Slam Brissett After Broncos Loss
